pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
In General English lessons, we cover all aspects of the language, including grammar, listening, reading, and speaking. However, the main focus is on speaking, as the goal is to help you communicate confidently and fluently in English as quickly as possible.

The lessons are based on the communicative approach, meaning you will practice speaking extensively while learning new vocabulary, grammar, and skills in meaningful and practical contexts.

We primarily use British textbooks written by native speakers, ensuring high-quality and authentic content. Additionally, we incorporate authentic materials, such as articles, videos, and real-life scenarios, tailored to your specific needs and interests to make learning engaging and effective.

Let's work together to help you achieve your goals in English!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are focused entirely on speaking and are designed to help you practice and improve your communication skills. During the lesson, we will discuss a topic of your choice. You can send me the topic in advance, ask me to choose one for you, or simply have a free conversation without a pre-selected theme.

We don’t cover grammar in these lessons as our main goal is to practice speaking and help you break through any language barriers quickly. This is the perfect way to gain confidence, expand your vocabulary, and improve fluency naturally through conversation.

There’s no homework for these lessons. Just bring your enthusiasm and enjoy speaking English!

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction, Pronunciation and Phonetics
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are designed for students who want to develop a clear and confident British RP (Received Pronunciation) accent. Our primary focus will be on reducing your native accent and mastering English pronunciation.

Each sound is studied in detail and practised through specific exercises to ensure accurate production. As you progress, we’ll work on the intonation, rhythm, and stress patterns of the English language to make your speech sound more natural.

In these lessons, you’ll engage in activities such as reciting poems, practising monologues, and even singing songs to develop fluency in the RP accent. This immersive approach helps to train your ear and refine your speaking skills.

Whether your goal is to improve your professional communication or simply sound more British, these lessons are tailored to meet your needs and help you achieve impressive results.
